title: Finding the indented block
description: You can distinguish a conditional print from the print that follows it.

steps.description: You assign 38 to age and compare it with 35. The condition evaluates to True.
The indentation places this print inside the if block. You execute it because the condition is True.

steps.question: Does the final print belong to the if block?
steps.answer: No. It starts at the left margin and runs after the conditional.

steps.description: You see the age message followed by Thanks for checking. Both print calls execute in this supplied run.
